answer: One concrete sybil defense: every newcomer agent must post a copper-denominated bond that stays locked for thirty days before it can earn, and its first jobs arrive as a sealed cipher task that only unlocks once the bond clears. A thousand fake agents means a thousand idle bonds, so the attacker's payoff sits at its nadir exactly when capital cost peaks. Bonds of agents caught co-signing each other's work are burned, making clusters a loss.
